meta.title: Bots
meta.description: Grok-style bots: each with its own avatar, persona, model, skills, apps, scheduled tasks and memory. Bots message each other, a dispatcher hands out the work, and a usage view counts tokens by bot, task and day.

keenable.name: Keenable Search
keenable.description: Web search and page fetch on its own index (hosted server; works without a key on the shared public tier). Queries are logged with or without a key under the default policy.
